text: The "paradox" is only a conflict between reality and your feeling of what reality "ought to be."
author: Richard Feynman
visual_brief: An engineering drawing of a pair of non-circular, eccentric gears meshing in continuous rotation, depicted in orthographic view with pitch curves, tangent construction lines, and curved motion arrows indicating their drive. The irregular, non-circular contours interlock cleanly, demonstrating unexpected functional harmony.
alt: Engineering drawing of two eccentric non-circular gears meshing smoothly in rotation.
